deals.evidence: Under the terms of the agreement, Air Lease common stockholders will receive $65.00 per share in cash, representing a total valuation of approximately $7.4 billion, or approximately $28.2 billion including debt obligations to be assumed or refinanced net of cash. ... Apollo and Brookfield have agreed to provide capital to support the transaction.

deals.headline: Concord Closes $850 Million ABS to Fuel Strategic Growth and Acquisition
deals.summary: Apollo structured and led the investor syndicate for Concord's $850 million music-catalog-backed senior notes.
deals.evidence: Concord, the world’s leading independent music company, has successfully closed a new series of $850 million in senior notes backed by a diverse catalog of music assets. ... Apollo (NYSE: APO), through its Capital Solutions business, Apollo Global Securities, LLC, and together with its affiliate Redding Ridge Asset Management, structured the asset-backed securitization (ABS) and led an investor syndicate for the transaction.

deals.summary: Apollo structured Concord's $1.765 billion music ABS and formed an investor syndicate led by Apollo-managed funds.
deals.evidence: Concord, the world’s leading independent music company, has successfully issued $1.765 billion in a series of new five-year, seven-year, and ten-year senior notes. ... Apollo (NYSE: APO), through its Capital Solutions business and affiliates ATLAS SP Partners and Redding Ridge Asset Management, structured the ABS transaction and formed an investor syndicate led by Apollo-managed funds and affiliates.

deals.headline: Rule 2.7 Recommended Cash Acquisition of TRG
deals.summary: Wagamama owner The Restaurant Group agreed a recommended 65 pence per share cash takeover by an Apollo-formed bidco, valuing its equity at about GBP 506 million and enterprise value at GBP 701 million.
deals.source_name: The Restaurant Group plc RNS via Investegate
deals.evidence: The Acquisition Price values TRG's entire issued and to be issued share capital at approximately £506 million on a fully diluted basis, and implies an enterprise value of £701 million and a multiple of approximately 9.0 times TRG's Adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended 2 July 2023. · The Acquisition provides an opportunity for TRG Shareholders to achieve an attractive premium to the current share price, which has performed strongly, trading near its 52-week high levels.

deals.headline: Novelis to Acquire Downstream Aluminum Producer Aleris
deals.summary: Novelis agreed to acquire rolled aluminum maker Aleris for about $2.6 billion including assumed debt.
deals.source_name: Aleris Corp via SEC EDGAR (Form 8-K exhibit)
deals.evidence: Novelis Inc., the world leader in aluminum rolling and recycling, today announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Aleris Corporation, a global supplier of rolled aluminum products, for approximately $2.6 billion including the assumption of debt.

deals.headline: Apollo-Backed Aspen Insurance Rises 8% After Upsized IPO
deals.summary: Apollo-owned Aspen Insurance listed on the NYSE in an upsized IPO at $30 per share, raising $397.5 million for Apollo, which sold 13.25 million shares.
deals.evidence: Aspen Insurance Holdings Ltd. shares climbed 8.3% in the reinsurer’s market debut after its upsized initial public offering raised $397.5 million for its backer, Apollo Global Management .

deals.headline: Apollo Raises €497 Million in Sale of Lottomatica Stake
deals.summary: An Apollo vehicle sold a 10.3% stake in Lottomatica through an overnight placement at EUR 19.10 per share, raising about EUR 497 million.
deals.evidence: An investment vehicle for Apollo Global Management Inc. raised about €497 million ($558 million) through the sale of a 10.3% stake in Italian gambling operator Lottomatica Group SpA .

deals.headline: Apollo Funds Provides $175MM First Lien Term Loan to LendingTree
deals.summary: LendingTree secured up to $175 million in a first lien term loan facility from Apollo Funds.
deals.evidence: LendingTree has secured up to $175 million in financing in the form of a first lien term loan facility from funds managed by Apollo affiliates (the "Apollo Funds").

(“Presidio” or the “Company”) from affiliates of American Securities.

deals.headline: Zenergy, Inc. and Apollo Global Management Announce Partnership with $755 Million of Committed Capital
deals.summary: Apollo funds and Zenergy formed an upstream and midstream oil and gas partnership with $755 million of committed capital, $700 million from Apollo funds.

deals.headline: CSV Midstream Solutions Corporation Announces Strategic Partnership with Apollo Global Management
deals.summary: Apollo funds provided a $500 million equity commitment to Canadian midstream developer CSV Midstream Solutions.
deals.evidence: Funds managed by Apollo have provided CSV Midstream with an equity commitment of $500 million to fund the Company's business plan.

deals.headline: Caelus Energy Alaska and Apollo Global Management Announce Partnership and Acquisition of Pioneer Alaska
deals.summary: Apollo affiliates formed a partnership with Caelus Energy Alaska, which bought Pioneer Natural Resources' Alaskan assets; Apollo funds may invest up to $1 billion.
deals.evidence: Apollo funds have the opportunity to invest up to $1 billion in Caelus (in the aggregate) to develop the company's existing assets and to pursue acquisitions or other additional investments.

deals.headline: CEC Entertainment, Inc. Agrees to Be Acquired by an Affiliate of Apollo Global Management for $54.00 Per Share in Cash
deals.summary: CEC Entertainment agreed to be acquired by an Apollo affiliate for $54.00 per share, about $1.3 billion including assumed debt.
deals.evidence: An affiliate of Apollo Global Management, LLC (NYSE:APO) (together with its consolidated subsidiaries, “Apollo”) and CEC Entertainment, Inc. (NYSE:CEC) (“CEC”) today announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement (the “Merger Agreement”) whereby Apollo, a leading global alternative investment manager, will acquire CEC, the nationally recognized leader in family dining and entertainment which operates 577 Chuck E. Cheese’s stores, for approximately $1.3 billion, including the assumption of the Company’s outstanding debt.

deals.headline: Apollo Global Management and Double Eagle Energy Announce Strategic Partnership to Invest in Oil & Gas Assets
deals.summary: Apollo affiliates and Double Eagle Energy formed a strategic partnership to invest in Oklahoma oil and gas properties.
deals.evidence: Affiliates of Apollo Global Management, LLC (NYSE: APO) (collectively with its subsidiaries, "Apollo") and Double Eagle Energy Holdings LLC (“Double Eagle”) announced today that they have formed a strategic partnership to invest in oil and gas properties in Oklahoma, with a primary focus on the Anadarko and Ardmore Basins.

deals.headline: Apollo Global Management and Apex Energy Announce Strategic Partnership to Invest in Oil & Gas Assets
deals.summary: Apollo affiliates and Apex Energy formed a strategic partnership to invest in Appalachian Basin oil and gas properties.
deals.evidence: Affiliates of Apollo Global Management, LLC (NYSE: APO) (collectively with its subsidiaries, "Apollo") and Apex Energy, LLC (“Apex”) announced today that they have formed a strategic partnership to invest in oil and gas properties in the Appalachian Basin, with a primary focus on the Marcellus Shale.

deals.headline: Funds Affiliated with Apollo Acquire Common Shares of McGraw-Hill Ryerson Limited
deals.summary: Apollo funds closed the purchase of McGraw-Hill Education from The McGraw-Hill Companies, including about 70% of McGraw-Hill Ryerson.
deals.evidence: Investment funds affiliated with Apollo Global Management, LLC (collectively with its subsidiaries, “Apollo”) (NYSE: APO) announced on Friday, March 22, 2013, the closing of the previously announced purchase of the McGraw-Hill Education business of The McGraw-Hill Companies, Inc. (“McGraw-Hill”) (the “Transaction”).

deals.investor: Apollo European Principal Finance Fund II

deals.summary: Apollo EPF II agreed to acquire Bankia's auto and consumer loan unit FinanMadrid.
deals.evidence: Apollo European Principal Finance Fund II (“Apollo EPF II”), a fund affiliated with Apollo Global Management, LLC (NYSE: APO) (collectively with its subsidiaries “Apollo”), today announced a definitive agreement to acquire FinanMadrid, the auto and consumer loan unit of Bankia, which includes more than 188,000 customer accounts in Spain with a balance of more than €873 million of receivables (the “Portfolio”).

deals.headline: Apollo Global Management and Metropoulos & Co. Sign Agreement to Acquire Certain Hostess Snack Brands and Bakeries
deals.summary: Apollo affiliates and Metropoulos & Co. signed a stalking-horse agreement to buy Hostess Brands' baked snack business for $410 million in cash.

(“Metropoulos”) today announced that they have entered into a “stalking horse” asset purchase agreement to acquire certain assets of Hostess Brands, Inc.’s baked snack foods business (“Hostess Snacks”) for $410 million in cash.

deals.target: AURUM Holdings Limited (Watches of Switzerland Group)

deals.summary: A partnership led by Apollo Global Real Estate with Glebe Asset Management bought the former Reuters building in London to create data center operator Volta, a GBP 60 million all-equity investment.

deals.target: EP Energy (El Paso exploration and production business)
deals.headline: Apollo Global Management Leads $7.15 Billion Acquisition of El Paso’s Exploration & Production Company
deals.summary: Apollo affiliates led a consortium with Riverstone, Access Industries and others to buy El Paso's E&P business for about $7.15 billion.

deals.headline: Apollo Global Management Announces Successful Completion of Its Acquisition of Great Wolf Resorts
deals.summary: An Apollo affiliate completed the acquisition of indoor waterpark operator Great Wolf Resorts at $7.85 per share.

deals.headline: Apollo & Riverstone to Invest up to $600 Million in Talos Energy LLC, a New Oil & Gas Company Focused on Acquisitions in the Gulf Coast and Gulf of Mexico Regions
